verified_sources.usage: semantic facts only, no task-content donor

p17.retained_operation: Finite fan-out: start one operation per input, collect all N completions/results into a slice. Do not discard this suitable donor to claim an original.
p17.local_changes: Replace random-number generation/printing with supplied deterministic jobs; extend each result with input index, value and exact error. Preserve all results including nonzero value plus error and wait for every started job after any error. No fail-fast, cancellation or panic-recovery promise. Do not copy upstream test cases or answer implementations.

Preserve Apache-2.0 header/full license and applicable notices; credit William Kennedy/Jacob Walker, clearly mark modifications. All other Ardan content requires its own bounded selection.

bounded_candidates.reason: None of the six S3 templates has an existing = iteration variable captured by workers held until the loop finishes. The data-race append exercise does not capture the loop index. Counter synchronization and generic launch/receive scaffolds would be nominal reuse, not this contract. This is a bounded queued-candidate comparison, not a claim that no matching exercise exists anywhere.

semantic_facts.version_scope: The pinned specification header describes go1.27; do not label the whole development checkout a Go1.27 release. Range := introduces per-iteration variables; = assigns existing variables. Closing a gate after the loop orders preceding assignments before receives, so wrong capture can be deterministic and race-free.
semantic_facts.usage: Facts only; no documentation example, prose, task code, tests or solution copied.

p19.dedup: Category/period closures retain constructor state; captured-method-values distinguishes receiver binding; StartJob launches one provided callback; range-offset observes copied elements. None assesses a reused loop variable behind a supplied gate.
